articles.title: Bahraini filmmaker Omar Farooq named UNHCR Goodwill Ambassador for the MENA
articles.description: Bahraini filmmaker and content creator Omar Farooq has been named a Goodwill Ambassador for UNHCR the UN Refugee Agency in the Middle East and North Africa The appointment recognizes his years of work bringing the experiences of people forced to flee to wider audiences Through documentaries digital storytelling and public campaigns he has helped raise awareness and mobilize support for displaced communities

articles.title: Iraqi migrant granted asylum after sleeping with another man’s wife
articles.description: The migrant claimed to have fled his home country amid "death threats" from his lover's husband, putting him "at risk of serious harm" upon his return.
